subject: Wellspring Health case study — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@wellspringhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0500
Subject: Wellspring case study — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Hi Sara,

Thanks again for agreeing to help with a short case study about how Wellspring Health is using Redwood Inference. We want to keep this lightweight — a 30–40 minute discovery interview with a couple of your stakeholders to capture the problem you solved, the integration story, and a few measurable outcomes.

Proposed agenda (draft):
- 5 min quick intros and context
- 10–15 min implementation + architecture highlights
- 10–15 min outcomes/metrics and business value
- 5 min any follow-ups / next steps

Suggested windows (US Eastern):
- Tue Feb 16, 10:00–10:40am
- Tue Feb 16, 3:00–3:40pm
- Wed Feb 17, 11:00–11:40am

We typically record interviews for internal note-taking and to extract quotes for the case study. If you’re comfortable, we’ll ask for explicit consent at the top of the call and can mute or stop recording at any time. We also have a short consent PDF we can sign if you prefer.

I attached a one-page preliminary questionnaire to help guide the conversation — no need to prepare heavily, just bullet answers are fine. Could you confirm who should join from Wellspring (names & roles), which slot works best, and whether you’re okay with recording?

Thanks very much,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Customer Marketing
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: wellspring_prelim_questionnaire.docx]

From: Sara Lopez <sara@wellspringhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Grant <emily@wellspringhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 14 Feb 2027 10:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Wellspring case study — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Hi Vivek — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear agenda. Emily (our Head of Product) and I would be the best people to join. A couple quick notes:
- We prefer Wed Feb 17 at 11:00am ET if that works.
- We are fine with recording for note-taking and quotes; can you send the consent PDF?
- We have a short internal legal review requirement: if there will be any direct quotes attributed to individual Wellspring staff, we’d ask to approve them before publication. That’s standard for us.

If you can include Marissa from your side (product marketing) and an engineering contact, that would be helpful. Looking forward to it.

—Sara Lopez
Head of Customer Success
Wellspring Health

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@wellspringhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Emily Grant <emily@wellspringhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 15:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Wellspring case study — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

On Sun, Feb 14, 2027 at 10:10 AM Sara Lopez <sara@wellspringhealth.com> wrote:
> Hi Vivek — great to hear from you and thanks for the clear agenda. Emily (our Head of Product) and I would be the best people to join. A couple quick notes:
> - We prefer Wed Feb 17 at 11:00am ET if that works.
> - We are fine with recording for note-taking and quotes; can you send the consent PDF?
> - We have a short internal legal review requirement: if there will be any direct quotes attributed to individual Wellspring staff, we’d ask to approve them before publication. That’s standard for us.

Thanks Sara — Wed Feb 17 at 11:00am ET works for us. Marissa will join from product marketing and Ben (copied) will cover technical details.

I’ve put together a short agenda doc and a consent form (attached). The consent form includes a short clause about quote approval — we can remove or reword it if your legal team prefers. If you’re happy, Ben will send a DocuSign link for signature; otherwise we can treat the email confirmation below as consent and we’ll still send the final copy of the case study for your review before publishing.

Calendar invite (tentative): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-wellspring-casecall
Agenda draft: https://docs.google.com/document/d/agenda-draft

I attached the questionnaire again and a draft agenda. Please let us know the names + titles of any additional participants and whether you want internal quote approval.

Best,
Vivek
Director, Customer Marketing
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: wellspring_prelim_questionnaire.docx, case-study-agenda-draft.md]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@wellspringhealth.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Emily Grant <emily@wellspringhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 08:31:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Wellspring case study — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Hi Sara — quick logistics note from legal/ops: we can accept the email confirmation as consent, but if you’d like an executed consent form we’re happy to collect it via DocuSign. I’ve started the DocuSign envelope — link below.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/consent/form/XYZ-987

If you’re good with the agenda, we’ll proceed to record the session for internal notes and to pull possible customer quotes. As Vivek mentioned, we will always send any direct quotes we plan to attribute for your approval before publishing.

Thanks — see you on Wed at 11am ET.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_case_consent-v1.pdf]

From: Sara Lopez <sara@wellspringhealth.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Emily Grant <emily@wellspringhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 12:00:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Wellspring case study — discovery interview scheduling & recording consent

Hi Vivek/Ben — thanks for the quick replies. Emily and I confirm Wed Feb 17, 11:00am ET. We’re okay with recording for note-taking and providing a single round of approval on any direct quotes attributed to Wellspring staff.

Ben — I clicked the DocuSign link and signed the consent form. Please confirm you received it. I also attached our logo for use in the case study.

Names joining:
- Sara Lopez — Head of Customer Success
- Emily Grant — Head of Product

See you on Wednesday.

Best,
Sara
